name: io.github.arena-agent/sprite-agent-mcp
description: Pixel art & sprite animation MCP server made for Arena.ai Agent Mode. Indexed palettes, seeded generators, hue-shifted shading, animation timelines, lossless PNG/GIF/APNG/spritesheet exports. Repository source is read-only for agents.

environmentVariables.name: SPRITE_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory where exported artwork is written (default ./sprite-output).

environmentVariables.name: SPRITE_AUTOSAVE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to disable session autosave.
